title: Act map — on the song's clock

sections.title: How to read it
sections.md:
**61 rows, all B-roll — no talking heads (§3A variant A, F3; §3C Music Video, V7.76.0).** Every lyric line is on a row — **108 of 108, in order** (checked by `work/actmap.py`). **`angles.py` PASS** (`work/angles.json`): 17 setups, no jump cuts, no angle three in a row, focus on the product on every product beat, kelvin per source, time only forward. Source of truth: `work/actmap.py` → `work/actmap_rows.json`; the `assemble.py` plan is `work/plan.json`.

**The clock (E6 + §3C, V7.76.0):** each row's cut is the **last beat of the song's grid at or before** its first lyric word's onset − 0.25 s (6 frames, §30H — never late; grid `music/MUS-BODY.grid.json`, 73.8 bpm pinned, beat 0.813 s, bar 3.25 s); it holds to the next row's cut; rows carry `section` (the §40A part) and `bars`; **Call (E6)** = time on screen + 0.4 s skipped opening + 0.5 s handle, rounded up, Kling 3–15 s, human motion capped at 6 s (`max`; anatomy and held frames up to 15 s). No row needs a split; **nothing under the 2.0 s floor** (fifteen short rows merged into their neighbours after the beat snap — HT10 one picture per idea; the EG05 montage is one picture). Total on screen 222.7 s = the vocal; the 5.3 s instrumental outro (222.7 → 228.0) is the CapCut end card.

**Mode 2 locks on every row:** image `nano_banana_pro` A/B pair (§6A short prompt, `PIX-SHAPE` cast, `PIX-SPLIT` + the front photo first on every product beat, `PIX-LIGHT` three sources); video Kling 3.0 with render rigs only — **RV sway** (the virtual camera breathes in place, never travels with a moving subject) or **R4** (a slow single-axis push on a still subject), `PIX-MOTION`, `prefer_multi_shots: false`; `NEG-PIX`. One-offs are written into their beat's prompt (§13): the bride, Loretta's husband (76, golf), the niece (22, track), the approachable sports doctor (§19B), the surgeon and patient, the PT, her husband, her sister (68), three church ladies, three montage wearers, the three younger women she passes. **Music register (§40A, E4):** each row carries its part's register for the record — the song's own arrangement is the music; nothing is added (Build Sheet §2).
